label: after
methodology: Fresh browser context per navigation, HTTP cache disabled, service workers blocked. Motion enabled. Serial samples, CPU slowdown 4 on both profiles. Desktop network unthrottled; mobile 150ms latency, 1.6Mbps down, 750Kbps up. Observe for 5 seconds after load unless AUDIT_SAMPLE_MS overrides. Resource timing totals exclude the document; CDP network totals include it. Gzip sizes in build.json are offline gzip estimates, not observed HTTP content encoding.

inp.reason: Unavailable. INP is a field interaction metric; these cold navigation samples have no user interactions or field data.
